sentences.text:
Author: Juvvadi Sridevi
Bench: Juvvadi Sridevi
 Hon'Ble Smt. Justice Juvvadi Sridevi
 I.A.Nos.4 and 5 of 2024
 in/and
 Criminal Petition No.13093 of 2024
Common Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 528 of B.N.S.S. by the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 6 to quash the proceedings against them in C.C.No.24 of 2021 on the file of II Additional Junior Civil Judge-cum-IX Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal-Malkajgiri District at Medchal,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A of IPC and Sections 3 and 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

entities.text: II Additional Junior Civil Judge-cum-IX Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal-Malkajgiri District at Medchal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for the petitioners as well as the respondent No.2,
that during pendency of the present Criminal Petition, the parties have compromised the matter and accordingly, I.A.Nos.4 and 5 of 2024 have been filed to record the compromise between them and to compound the offences.
3.

Vide order dated 28.11.2024, this Court directed the parties along with their respective counsel to appear before the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad, for identification and to submit a report.

entities.text: High Court Legal Services Committee, High Court for the State of Telangana, Hyderabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
4. Pursuant to the above said direction issued by this Court, the parties have appeared and the Secretary, High Court Legal Services Committee, has identified the parties and submitted a report,
dated 04.12.2024 and the same is placed on record.
5. In view of the above, I.A.Nos.4 and 5 of 2024 are allowed.

Consequently, this Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioners/accused Nos.1 to 6 in C.C.No.24 of 2021 on the file of II Additional Junior Civil Judge-cum-IX Additional Metropolitan Magistrate, Medchal- Malkajgiri District at Medchal, are hereby quashed.
